item.tib: rdzogs chen sku gsum rang shar gyi sngon rjes kyi tshig bshad kyi tshig don
item.coloph: zhes pa'ang rang lo nyer lnga par sha rdza pa chen po'i mdun du shar rdza wer snying gyer za g.yung drung lhun po'i ri khrod bde chen gling du rlung sems dbyer med kyi nyams len zhag brgya'i skabs phyogs du ma nas 'dus pa'i blo gsar gzhon nu du ma'i ngor sngags btsun bskal (skal) bzang bstan rgyal kyis (gyis) nyer mkhor 'phral du bris pa ste kun la phan pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
